svg.title: What a detector costs for what it finds

cc:Work.dc:title: What a detector costs for what it finds

svg.text: What a detector costs for what it finds
Untouched annotations against measured cost; both axes are lower is better
CPU: AMD EPYC 9K84, 16 threads per process, 24 concurrent workers
CPU seconds per 10,000 characters, log scale
cheaper and more thorough is down and left
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, 2 concurrent workers
GPU seconds per 10,000 characters, log scale
cheaper and more thorough is down and left
Quality pools every eligible dataset of a configuration; speed comes from one machine group, so the two axes are different runs.
Configurations without a run in the machine group are absent; dataset coverage differs between points.
No position here is a production safety claim.
